page_notes.394: 5-28 Aluminum Panel Mount Block dimensions; extracted 15 series 2425, 2425-Black, 2900, 2900-Black; skipped 10 series 2427/2910 (and -Black) and metric 25-/40- rows.
page_notes.395: 5-29 Panel Mount Block continued: material specs, included T-slot hardware, suggested panel hardware and required machining (Panel Mount Block Milling, ref. 11-42); data merged into the 15 series blocks from page 5-28, no new parts.
page_notes.396: 5-30 Detent Hinge Stopper 2054 and 2054-Black (10/15 badge) with included hardware 3056/3276; metric 65-2054 rows skipped.

corrected: 2480: description 'uncoated carbon steel' (not stated on page) -> removed
2425: notes 'panel bolt is bought separately' (inferred) -> 'chosen from Suggested Hardware table by panel type/thickness'
2900: notes added that 3671/3686 are printed with an asterisk (SS)
2900-Black: notes added that 3671/3686 are printed with an asterisk (SS)
remaining_doubts: Weights are written with ft²/m² superscripts; the text layer renders them as 'ft2'/'m2' (same values).

Standard Machining Services (Cut-to-Size, Shear-to-Size, ref. 11-25) and Required Machining Services (Panel Mount Block Milling, ref. 11-42) have no service number or series badge, so they are kept in notes only, not as machining_service parts.
On page 5-23 the Cut-to-Size table sits below the Diamond Tread Plate table; it is unclear whether it also applies to the Solid Aluminum Plate rows.
The Included Hardware (Mount to T-Slot) table on page 5-29 lists only the base blocks 2425 and 2900; that hardware is assumed to apply to the -Black variants as well.
2054/2054-Black are badged both 10 and 15; series is recorded as ['15'] only, per the rules.
